title: Lost Dogs Here Walk Home As PEOPLE 🐾
description:
You can't call a lost dog's name until it's home. It walks back as a person, and the name turns it back into a dog.

The Dales lost their spaniel, Pepper, on Tuesday. Today was the day he'd walk home. I sat on their porch step all day and helped them watch the street.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: When did Mr. Dale know: the doorbell, the vacuum, or the sausage?
